text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—I am sleeping.
Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With just those words,
Orfevre promptly climbed into bed.
choice_data_list: I'll come pick you up again later.

text_block_list.name: Vassal A
text_block_list.text: O, our King. Gaze upon those who bow before your majesty.

text_block_list.name: Common Folk
text_block_list.text: Our King! King Orfevre!

text_block_list.name: Vassal B
text_block_list.text:
This rich land, its people...
everything belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Vassal A
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us celebrate!
This is a world where any wish of the King can come true.
Please, do as you please—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. I must not underestimate fatigue.
To think I would have such a cheap dream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well, this too shall be entertainment.
To start with—you shall become a dog.

text_block_list.name: Vassal A
text_block_list.text:
Woof!?
What are you doing, bark!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. So you've turned into something like a werewolf, have you?
How uninteresting.

text_block_list.name: Vassal A
text_block_list.text: Y-You're the one who did it in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll go with a sea lion.

text_block_list.name: Vassal B
text_block_list.text:
Why, of all things?!
Ah, aah, King! You jest, surely!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...How dull. I feel no spirit from you lot attempting to entertain Us.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Even though I indulged you with childish play, thinking it was but a dream...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Useless lot. If they possessed true loyalty,
they would act on their own, just like that one—

text_block_list.name: Vassal A
text_block_list.text:
M-My apologies.
However... what on earth could that be...?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I'm bored.
...Come pick me up.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
choice_data_list: Ah, good morning. How are you feeling?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her complexion looks fine. Relieved,
and hoping to lift her spirits even a little,
I invited her out for a meal and a break.
choice_data_list: Or would you rather relax in your room—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. To think I'd be comforted by you.
How cheeky... and how amusing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The tense expression she wore before sleeping was gone,
replaced by a gentle smile on her lips.
It seemed she had fully recovered her composure.
